intro: Lesson 27: Review: purification and salah. To understand how the rules of purification and salah fit together as one system of worship

questions.q: Mixed case: Amina prays Maghrib on a clean mat, facing the qiblah, but forgot she had used the toilet since her last wudu. Is her prayer valid? What should she do?
questions.a: Not valid: purity from hadath is a condition. Make wudu and pray Maghrib again.
questions.model: Point: the prayer is not valid. Evidence: 'Allah does not accept a prayer without purification' (Muslim). Explain: the toilet broke wudu, so a condition was missing. Link: make wudu and repeat Maghrib.

questions.q: write two mixed cases of your own for a partner, with answers.
questions.a: Pupils' own cases using two rules each

questions.q: explain how this unit shows that worship in Islam is both outward and inward.
questions.a: Outward: purity, conditions, pillars. Inward: niyyah, khushu', tuma'ninah.

questions.q: Back to our ponder: which rule would you teach first, and why?
questions.a: Purity and the conditions: without them the prayer is not valid.
